segments.name: Specialty Long-tail
segments.description: Underwrites professional lines, financial institutions, marine liability and inherent defects insurance, plus facultative reinsurance, for clients needing long-tail liability cover.
segments.evidence: Our specialty long-tail segment includes (a) our professional lines of business, which includes our professional indemnity, directors and officers, legal expenses, intellectual property and other casualty lines of business, (b) our financial institutions line of business, (c) our marine liability line of business and (d) our inherent defects insurance line of business.

segments.name: Specialty Short-tail
segments.description: Writes energy, property and construction and engineering short-tail insurance and facultative reinsurance for specialty risks worldwide.
segments.evidence: Of $666.7 million in gross written premiums for the year ended December 31, 2025, 25.1% was generated by our specialty long-tail segment, 59.9% by the specialty short-tail segment and 15.0% by the reinsurance segment.

segments.name: Reinsurance
segments.description: Provides treaty reinsurance to cedants, assuming all risks of a specific class of policies.
segments.evidence: Our Specialty Long-tail and Specialty Short-tail segments include both direct insurance and facultative reinsurance (reinsurance that provides coverage for a specific risk or group of risks), and our Reinsurance segment includes only treaty reinsurance (reinsurance where the cedant agrees to transfer all risks of a specific class of policies to the reinsurer).

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums, sourced almost entirely through international brokers, for specialty insurance and treaty reinsurance coverage.
revenueModel.evidence: We source almost all of our business through brokers, with our top five international brokers producing 62% of our premiums in the year ended December 31, 2025.
